📢 Announcement Darius DB (Lite Version 0.1.5) — Unified Full-Stack Web, PHP, Mailpit & Database Stack by Darius Cumpio (MIT)

New in Lite Version 0.1.5: Database CRUD & Import/Export (Create, Show, Edit, Delete, Show All, .sql/.csv/.bak Import & Single/Selected-Table Export), 1-Click GitHub Updater & Auto-Restart, Toggle-Switch Apache 2.4 + PHP 8.x + MariaDB/MySQL (:3306) Stack, Mailpit (:8025), SQL Server 2025 auto-sqlcmd, and 1-Click Self-Repair.

Click "Check & Install New Versions" to discover and install the latest PHP, Mailpit, MariaDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Redis releases.
Portable & ready to go!

No database engines are downloaded yet. Pick MariaDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Redis to install cleanly into bin/.

☁️ Cloud Databases

Saved Cloud Connections, one-time Manual Sync, Daily Auto-Sync, and Daily Auto-Backup (1-Week Purge) — each in its own dedicated panel & modal.

Quick Provider Presets

Click any provider to pre-fill ports, SSL/TLS settings, and connection format.

☁️ Saved Cloud Connections

Stored locally in settings.json · Connect, test, export, or run a one-time manual sync.

🔄 Daily Auto-Sync Schedules

Automatically pulls Cloud → Local DB, Cloud → Generated Folder, or pushes Local → Cloud at your scheduled time.

📦 Daily 2:00 AM Auto-Backup (1-Week Purge)

Automatically saves dated .zip snapshots or generated folders and purges backups meeting your retention days (default 7 days).
